skillsMatch.description: Assessment of how well the candidate's skills match the job requirements

score.description: Score from 0 to 100 representing the degree of skills match

scoreSummary.description: Clear business-language explanation of why the candidate received this skills score

matchingSkills.description: List of skills the candidate has that actually match the job requirements

experienceMatch.description: Assessment of how well the candidate's experience aligns with the job requirements

score.description: Score from 0 to 100 representing the degree of experience match

scoreSummary.description: Clear business-language explanation of why the candidate received this experience score

locationMatch.description: Assessment of whether the candidate's location matches the job location preferences

score.description: Score from 0 to 100 representing the degree of location match

scoreSummary.description: Clear business-language explanation of why the candidate received this location score

industryMatch.description: Assessment of how well the candidate's industry background matches the job preferences

score.description: Score from 0 to 100 representing the degree of industry match

scoreSummary.description: Clear business-language explanation of why the candidate received this industry score

missingSkills.description: Details about the skills the candidate is lacking for this role

summary.description: Plain business-language explanation of which skills are missing and how they affect the candidate's suitability

skills.description: List of missing skills, each with a name and its importance level

importance.description: How critical this skill is for the role

decisionSummary.description: The overall hiring decision and confidence assessment for this candidate

reportHeadline.description: A short, punchy one-line headline summarising the candidate's fit (e.g. 'Strong backend engineer, weak on cloud ownership')

finalScore.description: Final overall score from 0 to 100 computed using the scoring weights

detailedSummary.description: A thorough business-language summary of the candidate's overall fit, covering strengths, weaknesses, gaps, and context

shortVerdict.description: A concise 1-2 sentence verdict suitable for a recruiter dashboard card

recommendation.description: Hiring recommendation: strong_interview = prioritise, interview = worth meeting, may_be = borderline, reject = not suitable

confidenceLevel.description: Confidence in the recommendation based on the completeness and clarity of the candidate's profile

strengths.description: Key strengths that make this candidate stand out for the role

title.description: Short label for the strength (e.g. 'Strong Java/Spring Boot experience')

evidence.description: Specific evidence from the CV supporting this strength

importance.description: How much this strength matters for the role

weaknesses.description: Notable gaps or weaknesses relative to the job requirements

title.description: Short label for the weakness (e.g. 'Limited AWS ownership')

evidence.description: Specific evidence from the CV illustrating this weakness

severity.description: How significantly this weakness impacts the candidate's suitability

redFlags.description: Concerns that warrant follow-up during an interview

title.description: Short label for the red flag (e.g. 'Frequent job changes')

evidence.description: Specific evidence from the CV that raised this concern

severity.description: How serious this red flag is

suggestedInterviewQuestion.description: A suggested interview question to probe this concern
